name: dataset20v3
description: 20 claims from 2026 venue papers, with references transcribed from each paper and 14 shared per-subfield norm cards.
notes: Claims name the subject and the bar but NOT the apparatus: no datasets, baselines or protocol. v2 named those and left the proposer nothing to design.

References are transcribed from the whole paper, so ~46% of their experiments are mechanism/external follow-ups the claim does not oblige. Score with the role split in norm_cards.eval.analyze, not full recall alone.
References are model-drafted and NOT human-reviewed; provenance says so and the judge is shown that line.
Cards are per-SUBFIELD: retrieved with queries built from the field name and taxonomy keywords only, never claim text, then served unchanged to every claim in that field.
subfields.json carries 10 hand corrections to the classifier; subfield_overrides.json records each with its rationale, and subfields_original is kept beside each.
